name: List tables with row counts
description: Estimated row count for every table in the current database, largest first.
body:
SELECT table_name, table_rows AS estimated_rows
FROM information_schema.tables
WHERE table_schema = DATABASE()
ORDER BY table_rows DESC;

name: Table sizes on disk
description: Data + index size per table, largest first.
body:
SELECT table_name,
       ROUND((data_length + index_length) / 1024 / 1024, 2) AS size_mb
FROM information_schema.tables
WHERE table_schema = DATABASE()
ORDER BY (data_length + index_length) DESC;

name: Unused / low-cardinality indexes
description: Indexes whose first column has very few distinct values. Review for usefulness.
body:
SELECT table_name, index_name, cardinality
FROM information_schema.statistics
WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND seq_in_index = 1
ORDER BY cardinality ASC;

name: Largest tables by rows
description: Top N tables by estimated row count.
body:
SELECT table_name, table_rows
FROM information_schema.tables
WHERE table_schema = DATABASE()
ORDER BY table_rows DESC
LIMIT {{limit}};

name: Column overview for a table
description: Columns, types and nullability for a given table.
body:
SELECT column_name, column_type, is_nullable, column_default
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = '{{table}}'
ORDER BY ordinal_position;
